accessDenied.title: Admin access required
accessDenied.description: The global glossary is a system-wide baseline applied to every workspace. Only platform administrators can view or edit it.

header.title: Global Glossary
header.description: System-wide terminology baseline applied to every workspace (unless it opts out). A workspace’s own glossary term always overrides a matching global term.

createDialog.title: New Global Glossary Term
createDialog.description: Created as a draft — publish explicitly to make it live for every workspace.

editDialog.title: Edit Global Glossary Term
editDialog.description: Updates are audited and apply immediately when the term is published.

bulkImportDialog.title: Bulk Import (CSV)
bulkImportDialog.description: Headers: Term,Translation,SourceLanguage,TargetLanguage,BusinessDomain,Definition,UsageNote,Priority (only Term and Translation are required). Imported rows land as drafts.

auditDialog.title: Audit History
auditDialog.description: Who changed this term, and when.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Term?
deleteDialog.description: This removes <term></term> from the global glossary for every workspace. This cannot be undone from the UI.

validation.invalidLanguage: Choose a language the system supports, or leave it as All languages.
validation.termMin: Term must be at least 3 characters — short/common words risk hijacking every meeting's STT.

toasts.published: "{term}" published — now live for every opted-in workspace.
toasts.publishFailedDefault: Failed to publish term (a definition is required).
toasts.csvMissingColumns: CSV must include at least Term and Translation columns.
toasts.csvUnknownLanguages: Unknown language code(s): {codes}. Use {allowed}, or leave the column blank for all languages.
toasts.bulkImportIssues: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} had issues — check console.

list.emptyDescription: Add a term or import a CSV to set the platform-wide baseline.

importTemplate.description: The file every workspace downloads to import a glossary. It is a file shape, not a list of terms: columns grouped Source, Target and General, built for any language pair from the per-language samples below.
importTemplate.statusDefault: Built-in default — no changes saved yet.
importTemplate.saveFailed: Could not save the import template.
importTemplate.resetDone: Import template reset to the default.
importTemplate.resetFailed: Could not reset the import template.
importTemplate.loadFailed: The import template could not be loaded. Nothing is shown so nothing can be overwritten by accident; reload to try again.

problems.duplicateHeader: “{label}” is used by both {first} and {second}. A header name or alias may belong to one column only.
problems.priorityNumber: The Priority sample for {language} must be a whole number.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Group, order, header name and accepted aliases of each column. Term and Translation are required by the importer, so they stay in their groups and cannot be hidden.
columns.name: Header name

languages.title: Language samples
languages.description: Sample values for the faint sample row, one block per language. A pair's file takes the Source columns from the source language's block and the Target columns from the target language's block.
languages.missingNote: A language without samples still gets a file: its Term and Translation cells show a placeholder such as '<translation in Korean>', never an invented word.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Exactly what a workspace downloads for this pair, including unsaved changes.

sampleDialog.title: {language} samples
sampleDialog.description: Values shown in the sample row when this language is the source (Source and General columns) or the target (Target columns).

resetDialog.title: Reset the import template?
resetDialog.description: Columns, names, aliases and samples go back to the built-in default for every workspace. This cannot be undone.
